en-us.meal_question: The food is served, and the others at the table are already chatting over their meal. What will you do?
en-us.meal_chat_player_failed: $me.firstname$ tries to strike up a conversation with $picked.firstname$, but it goes nowhere.
en-us.meal_silent: $me.firstname$ keeps their head down and eats quietly, listening to the talk around the table.
en-us.meal_quick: $me.firstname$ wolfs down the meal and stays out of the conversation.
